records.text: The account introduced as Lisa Knows alleged Owens sources nannies from an unnamed elite Jewish nanny agency, that the women are terrified of her, and that she is rumored to treat them terribly while NDAs prevent them from speaking out.
records.speaker: Lisa Knows (social-media account; identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: Ironically, she sources her nannies from an elite Jewish nanny agency. ... These women are absolutely terrified of her, and for good reason. It's rumored that she treats them terribly, and they have all signed NDAs, and they legally cannot speak out.
